ei.title: 함축 의미 추론 — 균류의 선제적 사고와 숲의 다양성
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고2

fullPassage: I suspect fungi are a little more forward “thinking” than their larger partners. Among trees, each species fights other species. Let’s assume the beeches native to Central Europe could emerge victorious in most forests there. Would this really be an advantage? What would happen if a new pathogen came along that infected most of the beeches and killed them? In that case, wouldn’t it be more advantageous if there were a certain number of other species around ― oaks, maples, or firs ― that would continue to grow and provide the shade needed for a new generation of young beeches to sprout and grow up? Diversity provides security for ancient forests. Because fungi are also very dependent on stable conditions, they support other species underground and protect them from complete collapse to ensure that one species of tree doesn’t manage to dominate.

questions.passage: I suspect fungi are a little more forward “thinking” than their larger partners. Among trees, each species (A)[fights / avoids] other species. Let’s assume the beeches native to Central Europe could emerge (B)[victorious / defeated] in most forests there. Would this really be an advantage? What would happen if a new pathogen came along that infected most of the beeches and killed them? In that case, wouldn’t it be more advantageous if there were a certain number of other species around ― oaks, maples, or firs ― that would continue to grow and (C)[provide / deny] the shade needed for a new generation of young beeches to sprout and grow up? Diversity provides security for ancient forests. Because fungi are also very dependent on stable conditions, they support other species underground and protect them from complete collapse to ensure that one species of tree doesn’t manage to dominate.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 나무들 사이에서 각 종은 다른 종과 (A)싸우며, 너도밤나무가 (B)승리를 거둘 수 있고, 그늘을 (C)제공한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① avoids(회피하다)는 fights(싸우다)의 반의어
❌ ② defeated(패배한)는 victorious(승리한)의 반의어
❌ ③ deny(거부하다)는 provide(제공하다)의 반의어
✅ ④ fights — victorious — provide: 원문 일치 ←정답

det.korean: 균류가 더 앞을 내다본다고 (A)추측하며, 다양한 종이 있으면 더 (B)유리하고, 다양성은 (C)안전을 제공한다

det.korean: 일정 수의 다른 종들이 주변에 있다면 더 유리하지 않겠는가
det.analysis:
✅ ① a certain number of other species — 원문 일치, 다양성의 핵심 ←정답
❌ ② one species of tree — 단일 종 지배는 위험
❌ ③ a new pathogen — 병원체는 위협
❌ ④ the beeches native to Central Europe — 이미 감염된 종
det.tip: 다양성이 안전을 제공한다는 글의 핵심 논지

ch: a certain number of other species
the beeches native to Central Europe

questions.passage: I suspect fungi are a little more forward “thinking” than their larger partners. Among trees, each species fights other species. Let’s assume the beeches native to Central Europe could emerge victorious in most forests there. Would this really be an advantage? What would happen if a new pathogen came along that infected most of the beeches and killed them? In that case, wouldn’t it be more advantageous if there were a certain number of other species around ― oaks, maples, or firs ― that would continue to grow and provide the shade needed for a new generation of young beeches to sprout and grow up? Diversity provides security for ancient forests. Because fungi are also very dependent on stable conditions, they support other species underground and protect them from __________ to ensure that one species of tree doesn’t manage to dominate.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 균류는 다른 종을 지하에서 지원하고 '완전한 붕괴'로부터 보호한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① stable conditions — 안정적 조건, 균류의 의존 대상
✅ ② complete collapse — 완전한 붕괴, 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ ancient forests — 오래된 숲, 다양성의 수혜 대상
❌ ④ young beeches — 어린 너도밤나무, 보호 대상이지 위협이 아님
det.tip: protect from complete collapse = 완전한 붕괴로부터 보호하다
